definitions.explanation: Something that is eaten for nourishment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|た}べ{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧{食|た}べ{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧{食|た}べ{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よくない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: Sweet food isn't good for your body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}くと→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食|た}べ{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦みたい→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: When I travel, I want to try the food of that country.

notes:
{食|た}べ{物|もの} is the general everyday word for food, referring to anything that can be eaten. It is the most common and neutral term.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {食|た}べ{物|もの}: food in general (everyday, broad)
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: cooking, cuisine, a prepared dish
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧: a meal (the act of eating or a sitting)
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: food products (commercial/industrial context)
- ⟦{食料|しょくりょう}→食料：03250_shokuryou⟧: food supplies, provisions

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{好|す}きな→好き：02355_suki⟧{食|た}べ{物|もの}: favorite food
- ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧{食|た}べ{物|もの}: sweet food
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{食|た}べ{物|もの}: food that's good for your body

FORMS:
Formed from the verb ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing). The pattern verb stem + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ creates nouns meaning "something to [verb]":
- ⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧: something to drink
- ⟦{読|よ}み{物|もの}→読み物：14216_yomimono⟧: reading material
- ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧: shopping (things to buy)
